fusions.name: Death Roll
fusions.desc: Clamps onto an enemy at or below 30% health and rolls, chopping for 22 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Mudbank Lunge
fusions.desc: Lunges at an enemy up to 5 tiles away and chops for 12 damage, leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of health the target still has, up to 60%.

fusions.name: Lie in Wait
fusions.desc: You are veiled for 10 seconds: enemies notice you 65% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Jaws for the Weak
fusions.desc: Against an enemy below half health, your damage rises 14%.
